messages.text:
BL-1704 — The full-stack stop and kill_all_swarm stop the ollama server the swarm started, with its model runner children, leave a server the swarm found running (named in the stop log), and clear a stale record - dead pid or a pid now owned by something else - without signalling anything
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Nothing stops ollama: `stop_ancillary_services.sh` (the full-stack
stop) and `kill_all_swarm.sh` are both ollama-blind (grep finds no
mention). A server and its 11 GB runner survive every swarm stop,
including the closing ceremony's sleep path.
Approval context: Second of the three tickets from your 2026-09-23 ollama ask (BL-1703 starts and probes, this stops, BL-1705 reaps ghosts). Please review the feature file. FIRM - only a server the swarm itself started is ever stopped (an external one may be serving the Local Agent chat); a pid is signalled only aft…
BL-1704 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1704" (or "reject BL-1704 <reason>") to act.
